newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SWISS CANTON APPROVES NEW OLYMPIC BID FOR SION.
newsitem.headline: SWISS CANTON APPROVES NEW OLYMPIC BID FOR SION.

text.p: Voters in the Swiss Valais canton gave the green light on Sunday to local authorities to press ahead with efforts to win the 2006 Winter Olympics for the cantonal capital, Sion.

In a referendum, some 65 per cent of the people of the canton, stretched along the valley of the upper Rhone between two Alpine ranges, approved initial funding for the project totalling 60 million Swiss francs ($43 million).
Sion, a 1,000-year-old city which already has a domestic airport, lost an earlier bid for the 2002 Games, which were awarded to Salt Lake City in the United States.
